summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S filed a Form 6-K announcing a binding term sheet for a global settlement and license agreement with BioMarin Pharmaceutical Inc. resolving all litigation related to YUVIWEL and navepegritide products. Under the terms, BioMarin grants Ascendis a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-bearing license and covenants not to sue; Ascendis dismisses proceedings and pays royalties of 20% of net sales in the U.S. and 18% in the EU, South Korea, and Brazil from first commercial sale through May 20, 2030. No deal value, premium, or board recommendation disclosed. This settlement resolves IP disputes and removes legal overhang; watch for the definitive agreement and royalty-term compliance.
